record.question: Which Commission report on Religious and Linguistic Minorities is to be presented in the Parliament?
record.explanation: Answer A: Ranganath Commission. The relevant report is that of the National Commission for Religious and Linguistic Minorities chaired by Justice Ranganath Misra. The printed future tense is stale: the report had already been tabled in both Houses on 18 December 2009, before this March 2010 exam. Its identity remains uniquely recoverable from option A. Historical/source note: Original tense is inaccurate: report was already tabled on 18 December 2009; Ranganath Misra remains the uniquely named commission. Reference: https://eparlib.sansad.in/bitstream/123456789/602214/1/104915.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
